mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate exceeds 5.5%, it signals labor market deterioration that precedes corporate earnings contraction, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when UNRATE > 5.5%, or Rank IC is negative over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential construction (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad consumer demand contraction that triggers corporate revenue deterioration, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or Rank IC for interaction falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When manufacturing output (INDPRO) falls below 100, it signals industrial contraction that reduces corporate production capacity and profit margins, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO < 100, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) indicates strengthening labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS increases, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When CPI inflation exceeds 220, it signals accelerating price pressures that prompt central bank tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 220, or Rank IC is negative over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in real GDP (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate severe economic slowdown that reduces corporate revenue expectations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when both GDPC1 and HOUST decline, or Rank IC for interaction falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During active monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%), increased borrowing costs reduce corporate investment and equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or Rank IC for regime falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.
